intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“讽刺逃学孩子 -> 普通逃学的限度 -> 1,600 英里纪录 -> Dover 到 Calais -> Calais 到 Paris -> 期待巴黎却到 Perpignan -> 被警察发现并送回 -> 讽刺性纪录”的故事线跟读。重点读清 play truant, unimaginative, as far as they get, put to shame, while playing truant, hitchhiked, Dover, in the meantime, Calais, lorry, as he hoped it would, French-Spanish border, local authorities 和 evading school。

sentences.text: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：逃学的孩子们缺乏想象力。who play truant from school 修饰 children，unimaginative 是作者讽刺语气的开头。

sentences.text: A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：安静地钓一天鱼，或者在电影院里反复看同一部电影，通常也就是他们能做到的程度了。读出列举节奏，as far as they get 是“通常最多到这里”。

sentences.text: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一个男孩在逃学期间旅行了 1,600 英里，使他们都相形见绌。have been put to shame 是被动表达，while playing truant 是紧凑时间背景。

sentences.text: He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他搭便车到了 Dover，傍晚走进一条船找地方睡觉。hitchhiked 和 Dover 要读清，towards evening 前后轻停。

sentences.text: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：第二天早上醒来时，他发现船在这段时间已经到了 Calais。When 从句后停顿，had travelled 是过去完成，in the meantime 插入读。

sentences.text: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：从那里，他搭一辆卡车到了 Paris。From there 承接路线，lorry 是英式英语里的卡车。

sentences.text: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他拦下的下一辆车没有像他希望的那样把他带进巴黎市中心，而是带到了法西边界上的 Perpignan。长句分成 did not take him、as he hoped it would、but to Perpignan 三段。

sentences.text: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他在那里被警察发现，并被当地当局送回英国。was picked up 和 sent back 都是被动后果，local authorities 要分块读清。
